title: Explicit Integrity Correction Authorization Input
description: The input accepted by the deterministic integrity-authorization builder. It contains explicit session-user event receipts, one author decision per issue, and the exact revision_patch_sha256 the author approved. It omits only producer-computed revision, draft, and issue-list bindings.

revision_patch_sha256.description: Explicit author-approved hash of the complete proposed integrity patch bytes; the builder copies and validates this value rather than synthesizing approval.
